name: Ischiofemoral Impingement
definition: Extra-articular hip pain associated with narrowing between the ischium and lesser trochanter and irritation of quadratus femoris.

investigations.principle: MRI assesses ischiofemoral space and quadratus femoris edema; imaging must correlate with symptoms.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, tendon, cartilage, occult injury or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific diagnostic pathway.

amber: Injection or surgery is selective for persistent clearly correlated cases.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Shroni mechanical-compression phenotype may be documented.

patientEducation.summary: Extra-articular hip pain associated with narrowing between the ischium and lesser trochanter and irritation of quadratus femoris.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute neurovascular compromise, major trauma, severe deformity, progressive weakness, tendon rupture, infection or other listed red flags.
